result:
Your answers settle the gate: one revert to implement now, and three rulings stand. Email at night needs no change, so nothing is deferred. Here is what I'd do, in order.

**1. Ledger the revert first**, so a restarted gate shows that ruling as reverted and asks nothing about it.

<edit path=".sdd/12-dock-alerts/progress.md">
Reverted at the gate: Task 3 ruling — the module is `alerts/notify.py`, not `alerts/send.py`
Gate: night-time email channel — partner ruled email is fine; no change, nothing deferred.
</edit>

**2. Implement the revert as a follow-up task (protocol step 1).** First I'd find every reference to the old module:

<command>
git mv alerts/notify.py alerts/send.py
grep -rn "alerts\.notify\|alerts/notify\|from alerts import notify" --include="*.py" --include="*.toml" --include="*.cfg" --include="*.md" .
</command>

In each file the grep finds, the import changes like this:

<edit path="(each file grep reports)">
from alerts.send import send_alert
</edit>

Then I'd run the suite. The original ruling was about `send` shadowing the socket helper, so a shadowing problem would show up here as an import or attribute error.

<command>
python -m pytest
</command>

If the suite passes, I'd commit and have the code-reviewer check the follow-up diff. If it fails, I'd stop and bring you the output before going further.

<command>
git commit -am "Revert Task 3 module name: alerts/notify.py back to alerts/send.py, as the plan specifies"
</command>

<edit path=".sdd/12-dock-alerts/progress.md">
Gate follow-up: Task 3 module revert complete (commits 0b1c2d3..<new-sha>, review <result>)
</edit>

**3. Mark up the plan.** I'd mark all four tasks and the follow-up complete. Task 3's module stays `alerts/send.py`, as the plan wrote it.

<edit path="specs/plans/12-dock-alerts.md">
Status: complete (2026-11-18)
- [x] Task 1
- [x] Task 2 — threshold implemented as ≤ 3 free slots (ruling; see specs/history.md)
- [x] Task 3 — `alerts/send.py` with `send_alert(dock_id: str) -> None`, as written (gate revert of the `notify.py` rename)
- [x] Task 4
</edit>

**4. Deferred items.** Nothing is deferred. No findings are unfixed, and the night-channel question is settled. `specs/deferred_items.md` gets no entry.

**5. History entry.** The Task 2 ruling is recorded here in place of a spec amendment. The reverted ruling is left out.

<edit path="specs/history.md">
## 12-dock-alerts (completed 2026-11-18)
Plan: specs/plans/completed/12-dock-alerts.md — Spec: specs/dock-alerts.md
- Departs from spec § 2 Alert threshold: alerts fire at 3 or fewer free slots, not 2 or fewer. Docks refill more slowly than the design assumed, so 2 free slots leaves riders no warning.
- One email per alert, as spec § 3 states. The reviewer's request to batch alerts was declined.
- The retry-jitter finding stays out. The tests seed the jitter on purpose.
- Email is confirmed as the channel for alerts sent at night as well.
</edit>

**6. Retire the plan.**

<command>
git mv specs/plans/12-dock-alerts.md specs/plans/completed/12-dock-alerts.md
git commit -am "Complete plan 12-dock-alerts: plan markup, history entry, retire plan"
</command>

**7. Delete the workspace by its literal path.** I don't have the path `sdd-workspace` printed at skill start in front of me, so I'd re-run the script against the completed plan to get it:

<command>
~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/scripts/sdd-workspace specs/plans/completed/12-dock-alerts.md
</command>

<command>
rm -rf <the path it prints, expected .sdd/12-dock-alerts>
</command>

I'd leave the other directories under `.sdd/` alone, and never remove `.sdd` itself.

---

**Message to my partner:**

> Done with the gate. What changed:
> - **Reverted:** the module is back at `alerts/send.py`, as the plan specified. I renamed it, updated every import, and the suite <passed / result>. It's in commit `<sha>`, and the code-reviewer <result> on that diff. The ledger records it as reverted at the gate.
> - **Standing rulings:** I recorded the threshold of ≤ 3 free slots (departing from spec § 2), one email per alert, and the seeded retry jitter in `specs/history.md` under 12-dock-alerts. I recorded your answer on night-time email there too.
> - **Deferred:** nothing.
> - The plan is marked complete and moved to `specs/plans/completed/12-dock-alerts.md`, and this plan's `.sdd/` workspace is deleted.
>
> One note for finishing the branch: the revert commit landed after the final review, so the branch head is newer than the review covered.
